description: LAN Player Limit Modifier for Minecraft :)

mods.name: LAN Player Limit Modifier
mods.description: Also known as LPLM, this mod allows you to change Minecraft's built-in LAN player limit of 8. This includes but is not limited to the Essentials Mod which when hosting, also uses this built-in limit.

releases.notes:
Should support any Fabric loader above 0.19.0 and any Minecraft version of Minecraft 26.x!
This build was originally made for 26.1.x, but it has been tested and working on 26.2, so no code changes were needed.

If the config cannot be accessed using ModMenu, the configuration file is located in the instance root then `/config/lplm.json`
This Mod has only been tested on versions:
- MC 26.1.2 (fabric loader 0.19.2)
- MC 26.2 (fabric loader 0.19.3)
